verdict.rationale: Push-based MFA with phishing defenses and admin-enforced MFA policies is a fair question for a business password manager, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no push sign-in, number matching, location context, or admin MFA enforcement for Proton Pass. Its TOTP code generation and Proton Sentinel account protection are different features and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an IT admin, push-based sign-in includes phishing defenses — number matching, location context, and admin-enforced MFA policies
